content.text: {"extract":[{"requirement_id":"R1","evidence":"Provide the replacement platform and deployment/support specifications for about 20 named users; address on-premise VMware and Windows/SQL Server 2016-or-newer compatibility and CJIS encryption capabilities, with web-based deployment preferred."},{"requirement_id":"R2","evidence":"Provide Laserfiche and Microsoft Office/Outlook interfaces and Minnesota Courts networking specifications; assess Active Directory and Citrix compatibility."},{"requirement_id":"R3","evidence":"Convert criminal case data from TCP3 and assess any necessary conversion of internally maintained civil-case data."},{"requirement_id":"R4","evidence":"Manage case contacts, documents, notes, tasks, email and calendar events with user-specific security and access."},{"requirement_id":"R5","evidence":"Support prioritized task scheduling, assignments, alerts and progress tracking for projects and files."},{"requirement_id":"R6","evidence":"Provide criminal/civil document search, retention and MNCIS/BCA/AXON interfaces; tracked e-discovery, original-preserving redaction/versioning, Bates numbering, OCR and batch document generation; victim/witness separation, diversion/specialty-court tracking, configurable file numbering, private notes, flexible case searches and reduced duplicate entry."},{"requirement_id":"R7","evidence":"Track contract expirations and renewals with calendar/task reminders and customizable contract reporting."},{"requirement_id":"R8","evidence":"Track claims with financial reporting and transfer claim files to litigation when lawsuits are filed."},{"requirement_id":"R9","evidence":"Generate criminal, civil, claims and customized reports, including MNCIS financial updates for restitution/fines, pending cases and VOCA PMT victim-grant reporting."},{"requirement_id":"R10","evidence":"Link email to files and synchronize tasks, calendars and MNCIS court dates with Outlook."},{"requirement_id":"R11","evidence":"Support mobile/remote and requested offline editing (connectivity requirements unresolved), multiple browser sessions, configurable required fields, validation, restricted fields, duplicate alerts/merging and single-editor record locking."},{"requirement_id":"R12","evidence":"Provide initial role-specific training, documentation, regular software updates, a formal upgrade/issue process and business-hours technical support."}]}
